{{Quote|Time to put the squeeze on 'em.|Rocket battle droid|<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
'''Rocket battle droids''', also known as '''hunter battle droids''' or '''pod hunter droids''', were modified [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, equipped with [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket packs]], [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutters]] and [[Floodlight/Legends|floodlights]], which scouted and destroyed [[Escape pod/Legends|life pods]] adrift in space.

==History==
{{Quote|Go get 'em, boys... Let's cut this can open!... There they go!|Rocket battle droids infiltrating Pod 1977|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
[[File:B1_rocket_corporal.png|thumb|left|180px|A rocket battle droids in space]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)]]'' in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']] was attacked and destroyed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], rocket battle droids were deployed in a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]] to seek out and destroy all survivors/witnesses of the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} destruction. Armed with cutting equipment, in addition to the standard blaster, these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] attacked the life pods that had been jettisoned from the ''Triumphant'', breaching the windows and dooming the survivors to die in the vacuum of space. After killing all those aboard [[Pod 1977/Legends|Pod 1977]], they moved on to the life pod which housed Plo Koon and his men. Plo Koon, however, was waiting for them, armed with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He and clone troopers [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] and [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] fought off the droids, before Master Plo severed the Separatist boarding craft's hold on the pod, and sent them hurtling off into a piece of debris, causing a violent explosion, and the destruction of the rocket battle droids.
